text:
maria: quick heads up — during this morning's EMEA import window ~10 leads landed in overflow even though SDR queues looked healthy. pattern seems like handshake jitter + enrichment returning late. anyone else spot this?

kevin: saw it in routing traces. enrichment callbacks for hubspot_bulk hit 30-48s, claim_ttl is 20s so we flipped to overflow before enrichment returned.

liya: two options: increase claim_ttl globally (risky for realtime) or add a per-route "late-enrich-grace" that keeps a short pending state post-expiry to allow reassign if enrichment returns within X ms. prefer per-route.

kevin: agree. propose config for canary on import route only:
```yaml
route: csv-import
claim_ttl_ms: 20000
enrichment_timeout_ms: 30000
fallback_policy: overflow
late_enrich_grace_ms: 40000
late_enrich_conditions:
  - enrichment.source: hubspot_bulk
  - enrichment.confidence: ">=0.6"
reassign_rate_limit_per_user_per_hr: 3
```

maria: safety checks: only auto-reassign if SF.last_activity < enrichment.timestamp (avoid stomping active reps) and cap notifications. also add logging events: claim_acquire, claim_expire, late_candidate, reassign_attempt, reassign_result.

ops-bot: hubspot: contact 00d9f updated (enrich latency 41s) event=evt_4721

liya: perfect example. with late-enrich-grace that contact would be eligible to reassign back to original owner instead of overflow.

kevin: rollout plan:
- canary 2% of CSV-import traffic for 12h
- instrument metrics: late_candidates, reassign_success_rate, overflow_rate_imports
- alert if reassign_failure_rate > 5% or overflow_rate not reduced after 6h
- rollback toggle ready

maria: I'll own dashboards and alerts. @support-team FYI — expect possible reassign noise during canary; mute noisy alerts as needed.

liya: PR draft forthcoming, will include opt-in flag `late_enrich_grace_enabled` default false and migration for new metrics.

kevin: small implementation note: when enrichment returns after fallback, attempt idempotent reassign only if contact.external_id matches and owner from enrichment differs from current owner. check SF owner_last_action_ts guard.

maria: runbook blurb for support: if rep reports missing lead -> check claim_acquire/expire, enrichment latency and source, late_candidate logs, SF last_activity, then manual reassign if auto-reassign disabled.

kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/lead-routing/pull/978 (WIP)

maria: starting canary at 03:00 UTC. will report 3h/12h snapshots. thanks. :thumbsup:
